title: Meet the council's standards, or get approval, to run a caravan park
what: Run a caravan park to the council's minimum standards (traffic, roads, parking, recreation areas of at least 10% of the park and more), or get the council's approval if it does not meet them.

laws.title: Toowoomba Regional Council Subordinate Local Law No. 1.8 (Operation of Caravan Parks) 2020
